test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Correct the underlined part of the sentence.

They have a __few__ juice in the jar.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. little .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"juice"** is an uncountable noun. When referring to uncountable nouns, the word **"little"** is used to denote a small quantity or amount.
 
• The phrase **"a few"** is incorrect here because it is used for countable nouns, while juice is uncountable.
 
• Other options like **"least," "lesser," and "fewer"** do not fit grammatically or contextually in this sentence.

Correct sentence: *They have a **little** juice in the jar.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of "little":**

 
 
• **Definition:** "Little" is used to refer to a small, insufficient amount of uncountable nouns.
 
• **Example:** There is little water left in the bottle.
 
 
 
• **Usage of "few":**
 
 
• **Definition:** "Few" refers to a small number of countable nouns.
 
• **Example:** There are a few apples in the basket.
